_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. deel.com is a single-theme Next.js + MUI marketing site: a white field, a #1b1b1b promo strip, a #201547 purple hero and a sky-blue accent chip. Its Tailwind @theme layer declares the palette, spacing, radius and type scales (exported under core.*); the measured roles under light.* alias to the declared values where they match.

sans.description: Inter — body copy, CTAs, tiles, footer links and every form control.
